entries.2ba321bccb270b2f: The company manufactures and sells automotive parts such as pillars, control systems such as distribution boards and control panels, and industrial robots (Uniro-bo) and automation systems. It also operates a racing circuit, leases warehouses and factories, and sells electricity generated by solar power.
entries.30cd7ae16b1e4d8a: Drawing on the know-how and advanced techniques in pressing and welding for automotive parts manufacturing accumulated since its founding, the company states that it values passing on the technologies for controlling the automated equipment required for welding and for assembly design. In research and development, the company is working on ultra-high-tensile steel components for lightweighting electric vehicle parts and studying equipment that uses collaborative robots.

entries.51d089b10dfbb0dc: Based on its management philosophy of 'talent development is management itself,' the company aims to become a company excelling in people and technology. Its medium- to long-term management strategy is to develop the Automotive Parts Business, the Control Systems Business and the Robot Systems Business as core businesses, focusing on strengthening customer-oriented sales capabilities, opening new markets, and expanding businesses through M&A of companies that fit its strategy.
